bio: Do you consider yourself a fan of mushrooms? If so, next to La Latina underground station... you have a must-visit restaurant! In this simple establishment, with a modern rustic atmosphere and a decorative theme based on the world of mycology, you'll find a unique menu, quite personal, where they select five seasonal mushrooms that take centre stage. Don't hesitate to ask anything you want about mushrooms, as they are happy to answer questions and show you books that complement the information!...
